remarks: Privacy, space, and modern country living come together in this beautifully maintained, recently built home set on a picturesque 1-acre lot! Come inside to a bright, open floor plan where soaring ceilings and abundant natural light create an inviting atmosphere. The spacious living room features a wood-burning soapstone stove and flows seamlessly into the kitchen, complete with quality soft-closing cabinetry, granite countertops, a farmhouse sink and center island. Sliding glass doors beside the dining area frame peaceful views of the surrounding landscape and lead to the back porch—the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind at the end of the day. The first-floor primary suite features 3 closets and a private en suite with a dual-sink vanity and walk-in tiled shower. A second bedroom and additional full bath with convenient first-floor laundry complete the main level. Upstairs, the spacious loft overlooks the living area and offers incredible flexibility as a third bedroom, home office, game room or guest retreat. The full basement provides excellent storage and houses the 200-Amp electric panel, 4-year-old hot water tank, water softener and purification systems. Multi-zoned heating and air-conditioning add everyday comfort and convenience. Outside, you'll find a heated garage with electricity and concrete floors, along with a newly built shed ready for storage, gardening, hobbies or a workshop. Best of all, the backyard overlooks Harris Hill State Forest, with 2,271 acres of public land and 13 miles of trails for hiking, biking and horseback riding. If you’ve been searching for a move-in-ready home where you can enjoy privacy, beautiful surroundings and the benefits of new construction, this one deserves a closer look!
